**Finding: compliant (preferred position) — no redline proposed.**

I read the entire agreement (single section, 75 paragraphs) and ran targeted searches for MFN-style language (most favoured/favored nation, "no less favorable", best pricing, right to match, first refusal, preferential rates). Results:

- **No MFN obligation burdening AP.** The fees provision (§5, p0023) is a plain revenue-share/sequential-liability mechanic with no benchmarking to third-party terms. The licence, definitions, term, warranty and general provisions contain no best-terms, match-the-offer, or disclosure/right-to-match mechanic.
- **Affirmative confirmation of freedom to deal elsewhere.** §1 states the arrangement is non-exclusive and "will not restrict Customer offering Inventory via other agents or otherwise selling Inventory to any third parties" — reinforcing the absence of any obligation to route or price in Kubient's favour.
- **Winning Bid Price (p0014)** sets a floor "no less than the minimum price that Customer has agreed to accept" — that runs in AP's favour and, per the direction guidance, is not flagged.

The single preferred element ("Customer has no most-favoured-nation obligation benefiting Vendor") is already met on the document's face, so the rule sits at preferred rather than fallback and no operative change is warranted.
